## Commit Messages

- Follow the conventions defined in [`COMMIT_MESSAGE_CONVENTION.md`](https://github.com/acmpesuecc/OpenCMS/blob/main/.github/COMMIT_MESSAGE_CONVENTION.md).
- If you need a new commit type or convention, propose it by adding to "TYPES" section of `COMMIT_CONVENTION.md` in your PR.

---

## Pull Requests

- Use the PR template ([`PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md`](https://github.com/acmpesuecc/OpenCMS/blob/main/.github/PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md)) when opening a pull request. [it will be already there :D ]

---

## Testing

- Write unit tests for new features and bug fixes.
- Ensure existing tests pass before submitting.
- Test database interactions and API calls where applicable.
